title: Feast of Crows
text: A field of crows, thousands of them, all facing the same way. They are silent, every one, and all of them are eating something you cannot see. Now and then a head lifts and turns toward you, beak wet, and then goes back to feeding.

options.label: Run at them, shouting, and scatter them.

outcomes.text: They rise like smoke, thousands of wings at once, and the air feels lighter after.
They rise like smoke, and come down on you, beaks first.

options.label: The wisest reads the omens in their rows.

outcomes.text: The pattern is a warning, written in black wings, and a useful one. The wisest remembers every line.
The pattern is your own face, picked out in crows, and then it opens its mouth.
